author: Zedther
body:
Hello.
I've said it before, and I'll say it again
rilomilo9 has a huge amount of infractions.
26 to be precise
12 Temp bans
1 Ban
3 kicks
10 warns
This kind of behavior is not acceptable.
He should be permanently banned without chance of appeal, his bad behavior has gone on long enough.
As well as him creating spam topics, with his text being all over the place, and caps constantly used.
